name: why-withheld
title: Why do these two share a grade?
idea: A shared grade can come from an uncertain direction, from criteria that conflict, from coherence with other pairs or from the family's limits, and the grade does not say which.
from: new concept · theory book ch. 10, 12, 19 and 21; postrank vignette a2 (pairwise support); picture: the relation matrix; clicking a shared-grade pair opens four tests (the isolated rule, the criteria's directions, stated alone, the family) and the cheapest report that states the pair, with its extra risk
credit: After the postrank theory book, ch. 19 and 21. Firms as adapted in postrank 1.1.0 (pr_case_krw). 12-school teaching subset as adapted in postrank 1.1.0 (pr_case_cde).
caption: Six fictional sites and restated finite teaching laws; case views carry their released conditioning, attribution and licence notices. Four nonexclusive tests under the supplied law; same grade means not compared.
